Morning selection

The original query read each chip/month event at the public Gamma API:
https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/events/slug/{chip}-average-rental-price-in-{month}-2027
Use lowercase chip names and full lowercase month names. Each quoted outcome
is Yes to “Above” the specified hourly dollar threshold. Bid and ask are USD
per Yes share. Distance from 50 cents is abs((bid + ask) / 2 - 0.50).

These nine lines transcribe the selected rows printed by the original query.
Provider updatedAt is the Gamma market time, not the client retrieval time.
The query selected from markets accepting orders with positive bid and ask,
minimizing abs(bestAsk + bestBid - 1) in binary floating-point arithmetic.
Python min retained the first result in API order if two distances compared equal.
